entry.kjv: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.
entry.text: A beautiful day is a good reminder of the pleasant places God has given you: a home, a town, people who know your name. Gratitude grows when we say it out loud. Tell someone today what you love about where you live.
